description: Port of Ruff's F842 (unused-annotation) with default settings (`dummy-variable-rgx` = `^(_+|(_+[a-zA-Z0-9_]*[a-zA-Z0-9]+?))$`), on the engine's usedness (M10a `binds` with form `annotation`, Ruff's unused_annotation): the latest binding of a name in a function or lambda scope that is a bare annotation (`x: int`, `(x): int`) nothing reads, not a dummy name. Names in strings Ruff parses as type definitions are reads (M11a).

violation.message: Local variable `$N` is annotated but never used
